title: One shot, re-shot from three cameras
pitch: One invented performer and one take in. The same moment from three camera moves, cut together out.
why: H3 makes the master take, then re-shoots that exact clip with new camera moves, so all three angles show the same performance.

models.name: MiniMax H3
models.note: Show the name in commercial products. Read the licence's territory terms before you rely on it.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: One clear action reads best from every angle.

steps.label: The frame
steps.prompt: Film still, medium wide shot: an invented man in his fifties with a grey beard, in a dark green wool sweater, playing a cello alone on an empty theatre stage, one warm spotlight, dark seats behind. No text.

steps.label: Master take
steps.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action. The man plays the cello slowly with long smooth bow strokes, eyes half closed. The spotlight holds steady. The camera stays locked on a medium wide framing. One continuous shot, no cuts.

overall_soundscape: Slow solo cello, a quiet theatre.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

steps.label: The cut
steps.does: Cuts between the three angles on the master's sound.
